Definition: A unique alphanumeric identifier for this learning opportunity that is used for your customers or for internal processes within your system.
Specifications: Published as a ceterms:IdentifierValue with Identifier Type Name "External Identifier" and the supplied value as its Identifier Value Code. It is also used to group rows for the same learning opportunity.

Definition: Name or title of the resource.
Statement, characterization or account of the entity.
Specifications: Must be a minimum of 15 characters.
Sample: This certifies that someone is qualified as a web user.

Definition: Webpage that describes this entity.
Specifications: Must be a properly formatted URL beginning in https://

Definition: Type of state of the resource in terms of its stage in a life cycle; select from an enumeration of such types.
Specifications:
This property requires a value from a controlled vocabulary. Select one of the defined values.

For the initial upload, this would typically be "Active".
Sample:
Active
Ceased
Ceasing
Developing
Suspended
Teach Out

Definition: The primary language or languages of the entity, even if it makes use of other languages.
Specifications:
Must be a known language name. If there are multiple languages, use a pipe-separated (|) list. 

If no language is provided, the value will default to English.

Definition: Set of alpha-numeric symbols as defined by the body responsible for this resource that uniquely identifies this resource and supports its discovery and use.
Specifications: May be used for course or program codes (ENG 101), or any other bespoke code used by the provider.

Definition: Resource carries or confers no official academic credit according to the provider of the resource.
Specifications: If the learning opportunity is non-credit, enter the value TRUE. Otherwise, leave blank.

Definition: Type of means by which a learning opportunity or assessment is delivered to credential seekers and by which they interact; select from an existing enumeration of such types.

Definition: Course requirements that are prior conditions to this course.
Specifications:
ceterms:prerequisite can have two values, each of which is a CTDL Class: Course or Condition Profile.

If the prerequisite identifies one or more required courses only, without accompanying textual information, the value should be the course objects themselves, using their coded notation values. Multiple courses might be separated with a comma or "and". Examples:
MATH 124
MATH 156 and CHEM 116
BIOL 219 and BIOL 219L and BIOL 220

If the prerequisite includes any contextual and/or non-course specific information, the value should be a Condition Profile and use the relevant properties associated with Condition Profile. Examples:
MATH 124 or higher
BIOL 219 with a minimum grade of C-
70% score on Information Technology Qualifying Exam and MATH 11003
Consent of the instructor
Students in the Honors Program and consent by the honors director

Definition: Statement, characterization or account of the entity.
Specifications: Use this property for the verbatim contextual or non-course related information in a prerequisite.
Sample: BIOL 219 with a minimum grade of C-

Definition: Learning opportunity that is the focus of a condition, process or another learning opportunity.
Specifications: If the contextual information includes reference to one or more courses, use this property for the course number(s).

Definition: Subsidiary conditions where more than one alternative condition or path has been defined that may fulfill the parent condition.
Specifications:
Alternative conditions are not necessarily mutually exclusive paths; for example, a set of alternative concentrations for a degree may allow a person to optionally complete more than one concentration even though not all are required.

If a prerequisite requires one of a selection of options, typically separated by "or", ceterms:alternativeCondition must be used. Examples:
BIOL 221 or BIOL 219
BIOL 10004, BIOL 10104, or BIOL 10284, or equivalent with a grade of “C” or better

The values for Alternative Condition are Condition Profiles. Each Condition Profile will contain information about one of the possible options.

Definition: Resources that must be pursued concurrently.
Specifications: Similar to ceterms:prerequisite. However, unlike ceterms:prerequisite, the value for ceterms:corequisite is always a Condition Profile.

Definition: Indicates a resource that it is advisable to earn or complete before attempting the resource being described.
Specifications:
Use this property for information that is recommended but not required. This information is similar to prerequisite; the difference is that it is not required. Catalogs often use terms such as "advisory" or "recommended" for this information. 

The value for this property is always a Condition Profile.

Definition: Estimated time it will take to complete an activity, event, or resource.
Specifications: Enter one number and one time scale. Ex. "12 Weeks".

Definition: Overall span of time it will take to complete the activity, event, or resource.
Specifications:
This is intended to indicate overall time span, regardless of what portion of that time is spent actively pursuing the completion of the activity, event, or resource. 

If a resource takes 50 hours over a span of 6 months to complete, use this to record 6 months as P6M.

Definition: Minimum overall span of time it will take to complete the activity, event, or resource.
Specifications:
This is intended to indicate overall time span, regardless of what portion of that time is spent actively pursuing the completion of the activity, event, or resource.

If a resource takes 50 hours over a span of 3-9 months to complete, use this to record 3 months as P3M.

Definition: Maximum overall span of time it will take to complete the activity, event, or resource.
Specifications:
This is intended to indicate overall time span, regardless of what portion of that time is spent actively pursuing the completion of the activity, event, or resource.

If a resource takes 50 hours over a span of 3-9 months to complete, use this to record 9 months as P9M.
